title: Experiment rollout gates and evaluation plan: checklist, metrics, and safety nets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a standardized checklist and evaluation plan for running controlled experiments (A/B tests and canaries) across Redwood deployments. The goal is to reduce accidental regressions in latency/cost/quality during rollouts and provide a repeatable decision framework for Accept / Iterate / Rollback.

success_metrics: Primary: Quality regression delta <= 0.5% on evaluation prompts (statistical test: two-sided bootstrap; alpha=0.05)
Latency: p95 for user requests not increase by more than 10% relative to baseline (goal: <= 300ms absolute p95 for hosted tier)
Cost: per-token unit cost delta <= +8% for baseline A; if >8% require explicit PM approval
Error rate: API 5xx rate must remain at baseline +/- 0.01% (any sustained increase triggers cancelation)
User-facing fallback rate (failovers to secondary model) <= 1% during canary window
gating_criteria: Canary phase must run for a minimum of 48 hours and include at least 10k requests or 3 statistically independent evaluation runs
If primary metric (quality) fails to meet threshold OR latency/cost thresholds exceeded -> hold rollout and open incident review with SRE + model owner
All data retention and logging must comply with privacy doc (link in 'links') before enabling debug logs in production
Feature flags must be togglable per-tenant for Dedicated/Private customers before scaling beyond 5% traffic
monitoring_playbook: Primary dashboard: Experiment Overview (variant splits, request volume, quality deltas, latency p50/p95), link: https://dash.redwood.ai/exp/6391
Alerts: quality_drop_alert -> page on breach of quality threshold for 10m; responders: PM, SRE lead, model owner
Cost alert: cost_runaway -> notify infra-finance and PM if per-token cost exceeds budget by 15% for 1h
Latency alert: p95_latency_regression -> create short-circuit route to fallback model for affected region if triggered
rollback_triggers: Sustained quality degradation beyond threshold for 30 minutes
P95 latency > 2x baseline and >500ms for 15 minutes
Unexplained increase in 5xx error rate above baseline +0.05%
Customer complaints escalated to CS leading to >3 open tickets in 1 hour related to experiment behavior
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal): smoke test on staging with synthetic traffic and seed prompts (1 day)
Phase 1 (canary): 1% traffic to variant for 48h, include targeted tenants with shared SLA; collect metrics and qualitative feedback
Phase 2 (ramped): 5% -> 20% over 72h with automated checks at each step; manual PM/Eng checkpoint at 20%
Phase 3 (full): 100% with extra monitoring retention for 7 days and rollback hot-path enabled
evaluation_steps: Automated metrics collection: compare variant vs baseline on quality eval set + user telemetry
Statistical testing: run bootstrap CIs and two-sided test; require p < 0.05 for claimed improvements
Cost/Latency analysis: delta summaries with confidence intervals and projected monthly cost impact
Qualitative review: 10–20 human spot-checks across representative prompts (Design + PM), documented in Confluence
Post-canary review: 1-hour cross-functional decision meeting (PM, Engineering, SRE, Product Ops) with checklist sign-off
decisions: Use two-tier gating: automated metric gates + mandatory manual sign-off at 'ramped' stage
Require per-tenant feature flag for Dedicated/Private before >5% exposure
Adopt existing dashboard templates as canonical experiment view (no bespoke dashboard per experiment unless approved)
Statistical significance default: alpha=0.05; for low-sample experiments, require additional qualitative review
